verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents change notifications that alert applications when a resource is created, updated or deleted, and OneDrive driveItems support delta-query change tracking, so file-change push plus catch-up is evidenced at a high level. The pack does not show that notifications explicitly cover driveItem content changes, nor does it spell out endpoint validation or retry behavior. Missing for 10: explicit driveItem subscription documentation, webhook validation/verification semantics, retry/delivery-failure semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
